tool_args.rationale: At H = 0.6, the pilot response is the sum of a saturating term and a square-root term. The five added observations across gradients are reproduced to rounding precision when inverse-gradient attenuation acts only on the saturating term. Submit that model for fresh confirmation at the target horizon.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: It cannot explain the response changes across the observed gradients.

considered_alternatives.option: Apply one gradient factor to both inflow terms
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: This leaves systematic residuals, whereas gating only the saturating term fits to the precision of the reported observations.
The two acquired probes already distinguish which term is gradient-dependent; the nuisance probe does not test that mechanism.
